title: Add Two Numbers
prompt: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in reverse order, and each of their nodes contains a single digit. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list in reverse order.
hints: Simulate addition digit by digit. Use a carry variable. Process while either list has nodes or carry is non-zero.
Sum = l1.val + l2.val + carry. New digit = sum % 10, carry = Math.floor(sum / 10).
Use a dummy node for the result. Move l1, l2, and tail forward. Handle different lengths by treating null as 0.
O(max(m,n)) time, O(1) extra space (excluding result).
